Description:
Proxmox Datacenter Manager meta package
 This is a meta package which will install everything needed to run a Proxmox
 Datacenter Manager server. This package also depends on the latest available
 Proxmox kernel.
Title: Proxmox Datacenter Manager meta package

Description:
Manage multiple Proxmox VE cluster and other Proxmox projects
 This package provides the API daemons of the Proxmox Datacenter Manager (PDM)
 which allows one to add multiple Proxmox VE and Proxmox Backup Server
 instances to manage them centrally.
Title: Manage multiple Proxmox VE cluster and other Proxmox projects

Description:
Function for various kernel maintenance tasks.
 This package includes kernel-hooks for marking certain kernels as
 NeverAutoRemove and helpers for systemd-boot
Title: Function for various kernel maintenance tasks.
